name: Behavior Callout
definition: Points out a user's behavior that is highlighted by the label, either in text or in a screenshot. References the labels to say something about a user.

name: Label Interpretation
definition: A personal understanding or interpretation of the label's meaning.

name: Recommendation
definition: Recommends the labeler to others; may include a link.

name: Self-Use Experience
definition: Describes someone's experience with the labeler or how someone uses the labeler; may include a link.

name: User Behavior Change
definition: Describes avoiding or changing interaction with a labeled account.

name: Creator Behavior Change
definition: Describes self-monitoring or self-regulation due to being labeled or trying to avoid being labeled.

name: Reaction to Being Labeled - Self-Directed Humor
definition: Self-disclosure of being labeled with a humorous reaction.

name: Reaction to Being Labeled - Angry/Complaint
definition: Self-disclosure of being labeled with a complaint about it or about its reliability.

name: Reaction to Being Labeled - Other
definition: Self-disclosure of being labeled with a reaction that is not clearly humor or complaint.

name: Humor
definition: The post uses humor, joking, sarcasm, or playful framing related to the labeler or labels.

name: Mentioned as Part of a Conversation
definition: The labeler or a label is casually mentioned as part of a discussion and is not directly the focus of the post.

name: Technical Issue Report
definition: A user mentions that the labeler is down, not working, incorrect, unavailable, or otherwise technically broken.

name: User Label Clarification
definition: An unsubscribed or confused user sees labels in another user's post, usually as a screenshot, and asks what they mean.

name: Feature/Label Suggestion
definition: New label suggestions, label edits, or reactions to new or changed labels.
